chapters.title: 01 · The trillion-dollar workforce problem
chapters.text:
American businesses face a two-trillion-dollar productivity problem. That is Gallup’s estimate of the annual U.S. cost of employee disengagement. People are on the payroll, but their energy, commitment, and potential are being lost.

Turnover creates another enormous business burden. Gallup’s 2019 estimate put the annual U.S. cost of voluntary turnover at one trillion dollars.

Inside a company, those losses become very concrete. A bad hire consumes recruiting time, salary, onboarding, and management attention while the team waits for results. An unfilled role delays work. A disengaged employee contributes less than they could. When a valuable person leaves, experience and relationships leave with them, and the hiring cycle starts again.

Gallup estimates that replacing a leader or manager costs around twice their annual salary. The business pays to find talent, develop it, and then replace it.

The problem is clear: companies are losing money through poor fit, weak engagement, stalled development, and avoidable turnover. They need a practical way to help people succeed throughout the working day.

That is the opportunity XQ Workforce AI is built to address.

chapters.title: 02 · The solution: XQ Workforce AI
chapters.text:
XQ Workforce AI brings personalized employee guidance, manager coaching, and workforce insight into one connected experience.

Imagine an employee preparing for a difficult conversation. XQ helps them understand their communication style, consider the other person’s perspective, and practice what to say. Imagine their manager preparing for a one-to-one: clearer questions, more meaningful recognition, and a development plan connected to what motivates that individual.

That is the workforce experience we are building. XQ brings assessment insight, coaching, and practical action together in the flow of work. Employees gain a guide. Managers gain a coaching partner. Leaders gain a view of progress across the organization.

The connection matters: better conversations create clearer expectations; clearer expectations support stronger performance; stronger support gives talented people more reason to stay.

chapters.title: 03 · Give great people reasons to stay
chapters.text:
Retention improves when people can see a future for themselves. They want to feel understood, recognize their contribution, and know how to grow.

XQ turns those needs into practical opportunities for managers: prepare a career conversation, recognize progress in a way that resonates, identify a development goal, and follow through. Those are small moments with significant business consequences.

Every valuable employee retained preserves experience, customer relationships, and team momentum. For the employer, that means fewer replacement cycles and more continuity. For the employee, it means a stronger connection between today’s work and tomorrow’s opportunity.

This gives XQ a compelling place in the corporate budget: helping companies protect the people and capabilities they have already invested in.

chapters.title: 04 · Make training work harder
chapters.text:
Now consider training. An employee completes a course, returns to work, and faces a real situation. That is the moment when guidance becomes valuable.

XQ’s development approach connects learning to the individual and the job. Use behavioral insight to make an explanation relevant. Practice a challenging conversation. Turn a learning goal into an action for this week. Give the manager a way to reinforce progress.

The payoff is faster application, stronger confidence, and a clearer path to proficiency. Companies can develop talent internally and make better use of the training they already purchase.

The same approach supports AI adoption: help people find useful applications for their role, practice them, and build habits that improve their work.

chapters.title: 05 · Keep performance moving
chapters.text:
Great performance needs ongoing support. Motivation grows through recognition, progress, useful feedback, and a sense of purpose.

XQ brings behavioral and motivational insight into that daily rhythm. A manager can tailor how they communicate, connect an assignment to what energizes an employee, and keep development conversations moving. Employees gain practical next steps and a place to prepare, reflect, and build confidence.

This is how we approach workforce maintenance: sustain the conditions that help people perform. Keep expectations clear. Address friction early. Reinforce good habits. Celebrate progress.

For leaders, aggregated insights connect those everyday actions with team development and business priorities. Individual support becomes an organization-wide opportunity to improve.

chapters.title: 06 · A small investment. A practical threshold.
chapters.text:
The business model is simple: forty-nine dollars per user per month, paid by the employer. That is five hundred eighty-eight dollars per year.

At a labor value of seventy-five dollars an hour, just over nine minutes of useful time recovered each week matches the annual subscription price. At fifty dollars an hour, the threshold is about fourteen minutes.

Think of the opportunities in a working week: preparing a conversation more quickly, resolving a misunderstanding, finding the right guidance, or applying a new skill. Small improvements, repeated across a workforce, create meaningful capacity.

That makes the buying conversation tangible. Start with an everyday problem, connect it to a measurable improvement, and show the value against the subscription.

chapters.title: 07 · Small gains. Million-dollar potential.
chapters.text:
Here is what that can look like at company scale. Take a thousand employees, including two hundred roles where better use of AI could improve productivity. At an annual loaded cost of one hundred thousand dollars per role, those two hundred roles represent twenty million dollars of workforce capacity.

If the company recovers five percent of that capacity, the annual value is one million dollars. At ten percent, it is two million.

The annual subscription for all one thousand employees is five hundred eighty-eight thousand dollars. In this capacity-value example, that leaves four hundred twelve thousand to one point four million dollars above the subscription: a seventy to two hundred forty percent return relative to subscription cost.

That is the economic potential of modest improvements at scale. Retention, faster development, and stronger manager effectiveness give customers additional reasons to buy and expand.

chapters.title: 08 · Make the value visible
chapters.text:
The path into a customer is focused: begin with one hundred to two hundred fifty people and a business problem that matters. Choose a manager population, a business unit, or a development priority.

Establish the starting point, put XQ into the working day, and track the improvements. Are managers following through? Are employees applying new skills? Is useful time being recovered? How are retention and proficiency progressing?

Bring those answers into a clear value conversation with the customer. The pilot becomes the starting point for expansion into more teams, more roles, and more use cases.

Useful support creates adoption. Visible results earn renewal. Successful teams become the internal champions for the next rollout.

chapters.title: 09 · A market with a clear buyer
chapters.text:
Our target customers are companies with two hundred to twenty thousand or more employees, where people performance has a direct effect on service, execution, and growth. The deck identifies professional services, healthcare administration, technology, financial services, manufacturing, and private-equity portfolios as priority markets.

The buying conversation can start with the chief people officer, chief operating officer, chief executive, or learning and development leader. Each has a reason to care: retain talent, strengthen managers, accelerate capability, and improve productivity.

Our commercial path is to land with a paid pilot, expand through the enterprise, and extend distribution through advisory partners and industry relationships. The base-case model projects annual recurring revenue of three hundred fifty-six million dollars by the end of twenty twenty-nine. Customer value is the engine behind that growth strategy.

chapters.title: 10 · Built around XQ’s advantage
chapters.text:
XQ brings a distinctive foundation to this opportunity: behavioral insight, assessments, coaching frameworks, and experience helping people and organizations change. Our assessment debrief experience gives investors a concrete starting point for seeing that expertise delivered through an AI guide.

The next step is to bring that insight into recurring workplace interactions and connect it to measurable outcomes. The combination is powerful: individualized guidance, manager support, organizational insight, and an ongoing customer relationship.

As customers experience value, they have reasons to renew and add seats. In the deck’s subscription model, improving annual customer churn from twenty percent to ten percent adds about twenty-five point six million dollars to projected ending annual recurring revenue.

Helping customers succeed strengthens both sides of the business: their workforce performance and XQ’s recurring revenue.

chapters.title: 11 · Help us bring it to the workforce
chapters.text:
We are looking for investment partners who see the opportunity to make personalized workforce support part of everyday business.

Funding accelerates product development, customer deployment, the value-measurement engine, and distribution. The immediate priorities are paid design partners, a strong customer-success motion, and pilots that become enterprise relationships.

The destination is clear: employees who grow faster, managers who lead more effectively, and organizations that retain capability and get more value from their people investment.

XQ brings the behavioral expertise. AI gives us the opportunity to deliver it at scale. A recurring subscription connects that ongoing value to a scalable business.

Join us in bringing XQ Workforce AI to market. Let’s help companies build stronger teams, keep great people, and turn everyday progress into measurable business value.
